summary_1line: Bhima and Karna engage in a fierce duel of arrows; Bhima repeatedly disables Karna’s chariot, forcing Duryodhana to send Durjaya to aid him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima slices Karna’s hurled golden dart into pieces midair with seven swift arrows.
Bhima’s arrows kill Karna’s white horses and charioteer, leaving Karna stranded amid the battlefield.
Karna and Bhima stand in their chariots raining golden-feathered arrows like two storm clouds over a battlefield strewn with fallen warriors.
